design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label

pass1.boards: every mine count 1 … N − 1 of every grid, each on its own seed labels
pass1.serialStatistic: pick 0 tile of every round of the grid in census order; upper = 2·tile ≥ N

pass2.earlyWindow: nonces 1 … n, n = the rounds the capture played on the seed
pass2.slot: nonce i plays the (i − 1) mod n-th captured round of the seed in nonce order: its board (N, m), the tiles it opened (the settled answer's opened tiles, then the mine it hit, then the rest of its planned order) up to its planned depth K; win iff none of those K tiles is a mine
pass2.units: byCell = per grid/mines/depth [rounds, wins]; Phase A epochs also carry the pooled return: ret12 = sum of floor(multiplier·10^12) over wins; meanD = sum of mult12·(N−m)·(D/N); varD2 = sum of mult12²·(N−m)·m·(D/N)²; D = 705600
